hypothesis.claim: Tensor-local INT4 probability trees conditioned on the preceding quantized symbol within each row reduce the pinned public trained-model asset while preserving its exact FX2TFWC2 bytes under inverse and deterministic repeat.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject this exact packing configuration if verified inverse/repeat differs or the fixed trained-model asset does not become smaller. Build, missing-evidence, malformed-input and resource failures are implementation or budget outcomes. No result rejects all weight modeling.

changedMechanism: Replace only the global INT4 symbol tree with tensor-local trees indexed by the previous symbol 0..14 and row-start sentinel 15. Reset context selection at each last-dimension row; retain learned probabilities across rows and reset them between tensors. Preserve all other models, metadata, payload values and order; public parent coder and weights retain upstream authorship.
invariants: CPU 2 only; preserve HORIZON sole observer, MIDAS and other owners. Install nothing; no corpus reads, training, native codec execution or model-value inspection for tuning.

Canonical discovery cgroup cap 536870912 bytes, zero swap, scratch 67108864 bytes and elapsed stop 300 seconds; aggregate compilation cap 120 seconds, each synthetic subprocess cap 15 seconds, each fixed model subprocess cap 45 seconds. No cap increase or automatic retry.

Freeze all source, installed toolchain and model hashes before compilation. Retain and verify source copies before compiling. Authenticate the 2930652-byte public model with SHA256 7f4db6c8c843a7e6264b6a48ed4805e9e431f543df7a9a0ecb37a35a5e4b8860.

First validate six synthetic populations using an independent Python range encoder and the unchanged public C++ raw/compressed tensor checker; only after these pass open the fixed 434-tensor public confirmation model.

Run 20 rejected-input cases, missing-row and missing-tensor reset controls, corrupted-input hash admission, preexisting-output preservation and stdout-write failure. Failures must not replace an existing file or publish a partial model as success.

Exact reserialization and inverse must reconstruct the original packed model bytes, including metadata, arithmetic flush and all stored payloads. RoPE tags preserve upstream generation instructions; do not claim independently regenerated real RoPE values.

Use one fixed context architecture with no development parameter selection. Public model was already part of the reproduced parent; no claim of an unseen generalization population. Confirmation is independent fresh-process inverse/repack with frozen sources.

Publish component byte counts and measured unpack/pack costs plus incomplete source and runtime inventories. Two-copy savings are arithmetic only; no scored gain until fresh native archives and complete package accounting.
Optional CPU telemetry failure is an explicit missing diagnostic. Missing mandatory source, file, process, guard or exactness evidence prevents promotion.

Close all children and output files before stage-decision; final decision/reflection requires canonical terminal job and outer guard closure. Discovery guard is operational evidence, not a complete v3 prize resource certificate.
A positive component result permits selection of a separately frozen native loader integration gate. It does not authorize a larger corpus run or automatically launch another job.
